_doc: Per-benchmark evaluation settings. Prefer per-question db_path in gold.jsonl (AMBROSIA/CLAMBSQL db_id is not unique across domains/types). db_path template is a fallback for BIRD-style layouts filled with {db_id}. gold is the y* key the paper reports: BIRD single gold; AMBROSIA gold_1 = first gold in release order (no labeled intent); CLAMBSQL intended = dataset-marked gold (not always gold_1). Float cells are rounded to 6 decimals to match paper_exp norm_cell / score_gold. See outputs/analysis/gold_sensitivity_NOTE.md.
